outcome: Concordance of cord blood lactate values
Negative predictive value (at 4.8 mmol/L lactate threshold)
cohort: The study included 101 cord blood samples taken at birth from a level 3 maternity hospital.
finding: There is a good correlation between cord blood lactate values obtained by the reference device (GEM4000(r)) and the two portable devices (Lactate Scout and StatStrip Xpress).
